script:
Ken (The Real Killer)
Congratulations, you have become Ken
It must be said that you are a successful killer. Yes, you murdered Johnny and created the illusion of suicide. As for that suicide note, you had prepared it long ago. Let's first talk about why you wanted to kill Johnny. Your father was once a police officer, but during a mission, he was killed by Johnny's subordinates on Johnny's orders, while Johnny remained at large. You swore revenge. You deliberately joined Johnny's gang, but because of Johnny's tight security, you had no chance to act. A chance incident led to Johnny's imprisonment, and the gang's internal structure became loose, giving you more information about Johnny. So within three months of his arrest, you kept planning how to kill Johnny in prison, because that's where security was weakest. During those three months, you investigated a lot of information about Johnny and imitated his handwriting to frame John, who was imprisoned with him. Three months later, you deliberately provoked a fight and took full responsibility for it. After some maneuvering, you came to the prison where Johnny was held. But Johnny deliberately arranged for you and John to share a cell while he moved to the adjacent one. To have a chance to execute your plan, you spent another 8 months observing Johnny's routine, looking for opportunities to act. For this, you even disguised yourself as a mental patient, often showing violent tendencies and fighting with John many times, making others believe you went crazy from the shock of being imprisoned. Ridiculously, your acting even fooled the doctor, who gave you a certificate of schizophrenia. Because Johnny's sentence was about to end, you had to hurry to act. Since the cell doors were blocked by padlocks rather than strict locks, you only needed long, hard tools to open them. You got wire from janitor George, telling him you needed it to unclog the toilet tank and wouldn't bother him anymore, so he readily gave it to you. Then at night you tricked John into eating food containing sleeping pills. After he fell asleep, estimating Johnny was also asleep, you used a mirror to check the lock situation, then used the wire to open the cell door, infiltrated 1602, strangled Johnny with the wire, then tore off Johnny's bedsheet to create the illusion of Johnny hanging himself. You used Johnny's handwriting to write a suicide note, hoping that even if discovered, John would be the main suspect. Then you hid the wire in the water tank of 1602. After completing these tasks, you returned to your cell, moved the clock forward 30 minutes, and attacked the sleeping John. He quickly fought back. During the struggle, you broke the wall clock. After a few moves, John still subdued you, then you each returned to bed to sleep. Until the next day when guard Steven discovered the body and called the detective, you were listed as suspects.
Your Dark Side:
You killed Johnny.
Character Relationships:

1601 John - Johnny's capable subordinate. You often fight with him, and he always thinks it's because of your episodes
1603 Andrew & Clark - You know little about these two, only that they live in 1603
Guard Steven - A small guard who can be bought with a little money or material goods. Although he often oppressed you before you were diagnosed with schizophrenia, you think he's the easiest to buy
Janitor George - A kind uncle who has a good relationship with you

Your Statement to the Detective:
Respected Detective:
I don't know why you've come. I think this is just a suicide case. I stayed in my cell all night. Because I have some mental problems with violent tendencies, I even fought with my cellmate John last night, purely just to vent the boring prison life. Now that my boss is dead, I want to fight again. I suggest you finish investigating quickly, Detective, or I might have an episode. What? You ask when I last saw the boss? Can't remember clearly - it was during recreation time a few days ago, but the boss likes to be alone, so we didn't talk, just nodded at each other. Oh, right, John seemed to chat with the boss for a few sentences - you can ask him. As for my argument with John last night, I was quickly knocked down by John. Anyway, this isn't the first time this has happened. Of course, the argument might have been quite intense, so I didn't hear any abnormal sounds from next door. As for the time of our fight, there's a wall clock, isn't there? It was broken during our fight - you can go see for yourself. I heard the boss also wrote a suicide note, and John confirmed it was the boss's handwriting, which means the boss really committed suicide. What's there to investigate? If you really want to say it's murder, we can't get out of our cells anyway. The most likely culprit should be that cowardly guard Steven. Maybe he was afraid that when the boss got out, he wouldn't have money to earn anymore, so he killed on impulse. Yesterday the boss was responsible for cleaning the bathroom - they had plenty of time to be together and communicate. When talks broke down, Steven killed him at night. If it really is murder, that's what I think. John and I can provide alibis for each other. We two are innocent. Please don't suspect us anymore.
acts_goal: Don't let others discover you are the killer
